scope: Four-stage tool refactor, baseline reuse, project ledger/Git/wiki, recovery, scoped BM25 memory, Tavily adapter and process diagnostics

phase_a.note: Includes legacy/imported launch tests before fixture collection was deduplicated. Phase B began only after this gate passed.

phase_b.test_execution: Fresh WSL temporary source copy; no secrets or training data copied; python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
cases: Explicit historical baseline reuse with one training slot
Verified accepted source automatically becomes the next task baseline
Corrupt or incomplete history does not trigger new paid training
Durable idempotent ledger and isolated project Git
Scoped experience retrieval, note replacement and index rebuild
Network quota and deadlines persist across restart
Resume after scoring and pending submissions without resetting resource reservations
Worker diagnostic fixtures reject nonfinite values
Missing required process evidence cannot be reported as successful improvement
Project CLI initialization, knowledge operations and historical import

live_gpu_acceptance.failure: SSH transport exited with code 255: banner exchange: Connection to UNKNOWN port -1: Connection refused
live_gpu_acceptance.initial_issue_fixed: Project Git now ignores global/system Git configuration and uses an isolated identity with hooks/signing disabled; an actual source snapshot commit succeeded.

tavily.implementation: search/extract, cited wiki notes, bounded requests and normalized cache

limitations: Mock/fixture tests do not establish recommendation quality improvements.
The new GPU execution path has not been accepted because the configured SSH connection is refused.
Tavily has not been verified against the live service without a local key.
Currency billing is not hard-enforced; time/request/job limits are enforced.
Controller/task recovery is implemented, not mid-epoch training recovery.
Local .reclab artifact references require retaining the original workspace.
